title: The learned net2 on net1 v7 with its u lowered by net1's capacity spread where it believes no stock flow
description: exp-rule-spread-v7-val-287: lowering the fixed rule's window by K times net1 v7's stated capacity spread past 0.15 lost with Cubic first (-0.17 and -0.29 against -0.06 for K = -0.4 and -0.8) and gained among copies (+0.11 and +0.28 against -0.06); exp-capacity-belief-v7-286: when the flow is alone a wide belief means capacity is overstated, beside a TCP flow it does not. The learned DAgger net2 already states p, its belief that a stock TCP flow is active. This exports each learned net2 on net1 v7 (round 29, iteration 39, seeds 1 to 3, model-truth-patch-src) plain (net2-v7-sN) and with K relu(spread - 0.15) (1 - p) added to its u (actors.SpreadHead, experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --spread K), K = -0.4 (net2-v7-k4-sN) and -0.8 (net2-v7-k8-sN), nothing retrained, beside the fixed rule (rule-u0.25). Question, stated before the run: does net1's stated spread, gated by the learned belief in a stock flow, improve the learned net2? Criterion: a K beats the plain net2 by at least 0.01 on the five-family mean over the three seeds, and does not lose among copies. Validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and 2 and 4 copies. If it passes, a K is chosen here and confirmed at campaign seeds 11 and 31 before any test run.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/r" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-u0.25=$OUT/r/rule-u0.25.onnx"); declare -A K=([k4]=-0.4 [k8]=-0.8); for s in s1 s2 s3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$s.onnx"); for k in k4 k8; do uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$k-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --spread "${K[$k]}" --s0 0.15; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$k-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$k-$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 20 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && for s in s1 s2 s3; do uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" "net2-v7-$s"; done
